name: @rvn/desktop
description: Windows-first local AI-agent runtime and MCP gateway with 218 configurable tools.
author: Adisorn

scripts.build: node scripts/write-capability-integrity.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && esbuild src/main/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --banner:js="import { createRequire as __rvnCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __rvnCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/main/main.js && esbuild src/preload/index.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=cjs --conditions=development --external:electron --outfile=dist/preload/index.cjs && vite build --config vite.config.ts && esbuild ../cli/src/bin/mcp-stdio.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=build/rvn-mcp-stdio.cjs && node scripts/write-stdio-launcher.mjs
scripts.build:main: node scripts/write-capability-integrity.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && esbuild src/main/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --banner:js="import { createRequire as __rvnCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __rvnCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/main/main.js
scripts.package:windows: corepack pnpm@10.15.0 build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never --config.win.signAndEditExecutable=false
scripts.test:e2e: node node_modules/electron/install.js && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && esbuild src/main/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --banner:js="import { createRequire as __rvnCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __rvnCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/main/main.js && esbuild src/preload/index.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=cjs --conditions=development --external:electron --outfile=dist/preload/index.cjs && vite build --config vite.config.ts && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
